title: HTTP / REST connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One HTTP connector instance's settings: the sink's request template and retries, and the polling source's request template, cursor and items pointers, poll interval and rate limit. One instance may declare both directions; a route uses the one it needs. `auth.basic.password`, `auth.bearer_token` and `tls.key_pem` resolve through the namespace's secret store (D189) and are exactly the manifest's `secrets` list.

url.description: The sink's endpoint, or the polling source's request URL. Required: an instance has no meaning without it.

mode.description: The CloudEvents content mode the sink sends: binary (ce-* headers) or structured (a JSON envelope body). §33 §6 has HTTP sinks send ce-* headers and Idempotency-Key: <ce_id> in binary mode.

headers.description: Static request headers, as name to value. A secret-bearing header belongs in `auth` or `tls` instead, so nothing here is writeOnly.

body_template.description: The sink's request body template, with {ce_json} and the event's own fields as placeholders.

response_cursor_pointer.description: A JSON pointer into the poll response that holds the next cursor; the source's position is that value (CN1 Task 4).

response_cursor_header.description: A Link header parsed for the cursor, where the API paginates by Link rather than by body (CN1 Task 4).

items_pointer.description: A JSON pointer into the poll response that holds the array of items; one event is emitted per item (CN1 Task 4).

item_key_pointer.description: A JSON pointer to the item field that goes into the event id, "<url>#<item key>" (CN1 Task 4). The first field is used when absent.

cursor_param.description: The query parameter the cursor is sent back on, so the next poll resumes from it.

rate_limit_per_sec.description: The source's request ceiling; the source sleeps to stay under it (CN1 Task 4).

retry_attempts.description: Attempts before an event goes to the DLQ (CN1 Task 4: exponential backoff 100 ms to 30 s, 10 attempts).

retry_base_ms.description: The first backoff step; each further attempt doubles it up to 30 s.

dlq_topic.description: The Fabric topic 4xx responses other than 408, 425 and 429 go to (CN1 Task 4).

auth.description: How the call authenticates; the manifest's auth slugs none, basic, key, oauth2, jwt and mtls (§33 Appendix A.17).

password.description: The basic-auth password. Resolved through the secret store (D189); never stored in the instance.

bearer_token.description: An Authorization: Bearer token, the `key` and `oauth2` slugs' usual form. Resolved through the secret store (D189).

jwt.description: A JWT presented as a bearer token, when the target validates its signature rather than an opaque token.

oauth2.description: OAuth2 client-credentials settings; the token is fetched and cached rather than stored.

client_secret.description: The client secret. Resolved through the secret store (D189).

tls.description: TLS material for an https:// URL.

key_pem.description: The client certificate's private key, for the `mtls` auth slug. Resolved through the secret store (D189).

verify_full.description: Whether the server certificate's hostname is verified.
